meta.name: add-ollama-tool
meta.description: Add Ollama MCP server so the container agent can call local models and optionally manage the Ollama model library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地大模型并管理模型库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中运行本地大模型并管理模型库
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local models and manage model library
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run local LLMs in containers and manage model libraries

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会多出连接本机 Ollama 的工具:可列出已装模型、向指定模型发请求取回复;若开启管理开关,还能拉取、删除模型,查看模型详情和内存中正在运行的模型。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求使用 Ollama 或本地模型完成任务,或要求拉取、删除、查看模型时触发。

say.text: 用 ollama 告诉我法国首都
say.note: Claude 会先列出模型,再调用生成工具回答。
若已开启管理工具,会执行拉取下载。

say.text: 哪些 ollama 模型正在内存中运行?
say.note: 会调用列表查看正在加载的模型。

howto.what_en: Adds a local Ollama MCP server so Claude can list installed models, ask a chosen model for a response, and optionally pull, delete, inspect, or list running models when management is enabled.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user explicitly asks to use Ollama or local models, or to pull, delete, inspect, or list models.

say_en.text: Use ollama to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: Claude lists models, then calls generate.
Triggers a model pull if management tools are on.

say_en.text: Which ollama models are currently loaded in memory?
